czwartek, 26 sierpnia 2021 o 05:59:25 UTC+2 ar3...@columbia.edu napisał(a):
Hello, I'm having an issue with the proteinSummarization command. When I try to run it, I get the following error:

"Error in vecseq(f__, len__, if (allow.cartesian || notjoin || !anyDuplicated(f__,  : 
  Join results in 4616988 rows; more than 3620460 = nrow(x)+nrow(i). Check for duplicate key values in i each of which join to the same group in x over and over again. If that's ok, try by=.EACHI to run j for each group to avoid the large allocation. If you are sure you wish to proceed, rerun with allow.cartesian=TRUE. Otherwise, please search for this error message in the FAQ, Wiki, Stack Overflow and data.table issue tracker for advice."

I've attached my annotation file which I believe is source of the error. I've also attached an older version of the annotation which worked, but I wanted to group samples of similar types so that I could do comparisons across these groups, so I started tweaking the annotation file and things stopped working.

 Any idea what's wrong with my new annotation file?  Or if this is due to something else?
